briefTitle: A Study of VET3-TGI in Patients With Solid Tumors

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have pathologically confirmed, advanced, unresectable, or metastatic solid tumors.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Broad solid tumor inclusion mentioning NSCLC as part of a basket trial without a specific stage list or NSCLC-only restriction.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Failed, intolerant to, or refused potentially curative treatment options, including but not limited to, standard of care molecularly targeted agents, immunotherapy (e.g., anti -pembrolizumab/PDL1 antibodies), and chemotherapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy requirement is framed as having failed or refused standard options rather than a specific prior line count or typed prior therapy list.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease as per RECIST 1.1 criteria
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: At least one tumor amenable to safe ITu injections and/or biopsies
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Procedural feasibility for injections and biopsies is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Demonstrate adequate organ function
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General adequate organ function without specific numeric cutoffs provided in the text.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must be willing to comply with all protocol procedures and adhere to post-treatment care instructions
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to comply is a subjective behavioral assessment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior systemic therapy washout (dependent upon the therapy)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window is variable and dependent upon the therapy, not a fixed simple cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Requires use of anti-platelet or anti-coagulant therapy that cannot be safely suspended for per protocol biopsies or intra-tumoral injections.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Safety assessment regarding suspension of anti-coagulant therapy is a clinical judgment.
